meta.basedOn: ui/design-system (@fohte/ui): every token not listed here (base palette, tints, radius scale, fonts, text-2xs, spacing) comes from it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind a bottom sheet or modal.

tokens.name: status-completed
tokens.usage: StatusIcon fill for a task closed as done. Aliases @fohte/ui tint-magenta-foreground (dark). Never for GitHub state.

tokens.name: github-open
tokens.usage: GitHub PR/issue open icon. Aliases @fohte/ui tint-green-foreground (dark).

tokens.name: github-closed
tokens.usage: GitHub PR/issue closed icon. Aliases @fohte/ui tint-red-foreground (dark).

tokens.name: github-merged
tokens.usage: GitHub PR merged icon. Aliases @fohte/ui tint-magenta-foreground (dark). Never for task status.

families.sans: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Hiragino Sans', Meiryo, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.sample: 請求書の送付先を確認する
styles.usage: Task and project title on detail screens (text-2xl bold).

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Screen titles on phones, the focus task title (text-xl bold).

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: 先方の担当者に確認してから進める。

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: ScreenHeaderBar height (h-10); the sidebar header row matches it.

tokens.name: width-detail-sidebar
tokens.usage: DetailSidebarPanel on task and project detail (w-60).

tokens.name: width-reading
tokens.usage: Max width of a screen's body (max-w-3xl).

tokens.name: radius-task-filter-value
tokens.usage: The tinted value in a TaskFilterChip only.

tokens.name: radius-inline-code
tokens.usage: Inline code inside the markdown editor only.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: ModalPanel (shadow-2xl), with a 1px ring of foreground at 10%.
